title: 基于轻量级多模态大模型的电力设备缺陷分级方法
summary: 提出一种基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的电力设备缺陷分级框架。通过上下文学习最大化商用MLLM潜力，利用思维链问答对微调Qwen3-VL-8B，仅微调语言层即达最优性能，多任务联合微调验证了单一轻量级MLLM处理多个分级任务的可行性。
summary_en: Proposes a defect grading framework for power transmission equipment based on multimodal LLMs. Maximizes commercial MLLM potential via in-context learning, uses chain-of-thought Q&A pairs to fine-tune Qwen3-VL-8B, achieving SOTA by only fine-tuning the language layer. Multi-task joint fine-tuning validates handling multiple grading tasks with a single lightweight MLLM.
